ttresearch.page.REMOTE_PLACER.0:
You found a way to make a dispenser reach further than its own face. The remote placer holds a block, and when it gets a redstone pulse it puts that block down in the empty space in front of it, from one to four blocks away. A phantom builder does the placing, so a block does whatever it would do when you placed it yourself.

Place it looking at the direction you want it to work in: the marked face of the block shows where it aims.
ttresearch.page.REMOTE_PLACER.1:
Sneak and right click the remote placer with a wand to open its interface, where you put the block in and choose the distance with the four buttons. A plain right click with a wand turns the marked face towards the side you clicked.

It can be camouflaged, too: right click it with any block to make it look like that block, and with an empty hand to take the cover off.
ttresearch.page.INTERFACE.0:
The thing is, there's only six sides to a block..." - Direwolf20

Myth = Busted! Your latest construct can be bound to a block in the nearby vicinity. Its sides will mimic the sides of the block selected, and it'll function as an extension. It can accept essentia, items and liquids, being able to also export the latter two. Power does not pass through it in this version.
[continued]
ttresearch.page.GOLEM_CONNECTOR.0: By exploring what you can do with motion, tools, and a little bit of order, you have discovered how to make those golems just a tiny bit more obedient! You discover a block that can be bound to a golem nearby. It is meant to let a computer placed by it read the mind of the golem and 'convince' it to do as the computer asks, but the computer link is not part of this version: for now the block only remembers its golem.
ttresearch.page.GOLEM_CONNECTOR.3: The method documentation for this block described the computer link, which is not part of this version yet. There is nothing to look up for now.
tooltip.thaumictinkerer.golem_connector: The computer link and the golem data are not part of this version yet.
